title: Offline repair: isolate GMGN CLI credentials, classify sanitized failures, and add cumulative-holdings adapter contract
objective: Repair the GMGN portfolio integration offline before any re-run. Extract a minimal command/environment boundary that distinguishes API-key-only 7d/30d stats from signed cumulative holdings snapshots; prevent ambient .env/global-config credential leakage into either subprocess; preserve no-private-key stats isolation; classify child failures only into stable allowlisted codes without retaining raw stdout/stderr; define cursor/completeness behavior and sanitized cumulative holdings normalization. All acceptance must use synthetic fixtures and make zero provider requests. This task does not execute a live smoke, does not re-run 100 or 1433 wallets, and does not claim cumulative data was fetched.
forbidden_actions: Do not invoke GMGN, Helius, Chain.fm, Dune, any browser, or any provider/network request.

Do not read, print, persist, commit, or test against GMGN_API_KEY, GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY, credential-bearing URLs, signatures, raw provider payloads, raw stdout/stderr, complete exceptions, plaintext wallet addresses, labels, or external address files.
Do not modify the completed 100-wallet or 1433-wallet live outputs, their historical acceptance reports, task status, or task input manifests.

Do not re-run the 100-wallet or 1433-wallet jobs, add retry loops, add pagination loops, add background work, add a scheduler, add Helius, add another provider, write a database/cache/queue, or introduce wallet quality ratings or LLM conclusions.
Do not use the unsupported local gmgn-cli --sell-out flag. The pinned CLI contract must be detected and modeled through an explicit versioned capability.
Do not claim that a signed cumulative holdings request has succeeded; live validation is a separately dispatched task after this repair and independent audit.
deliverables: A pure GMGN CLI boundary with explicit stats versus signed-holdings modes, command builders, isolated child environment plan, and safe failure classifier.
A pure cumulative holdings parser/normalizer with all-time field semantics, cursor-aware completeness, null-for-missing behavior, and source=gmgn / verificationStatus=unverified invariants.
Synthetic fixtures/tests covering API-key-only isolation, signed isolation, unsupported command flags, safe diagnostic classification, cursor partial/complete handling, and evidence renderer privacy.
